expectations.buyer: PLC engineering teams, system integrators, machine builders, migration programme owners, and industrial cyber or safety reviewers
expectations.pain: A legacy PLC project appears convertible but obsolete instructions, hardware dependencies, safety blocks, communications, and field topology fail during migration
expectations.strongestIncumbent: OEM migration tools and compatibility guides, TIA Portal and Studio 5000 conversion workflows, integrator scripts, simulation, FAT/SAT, and manual code review
expectations.biggestRisk: OEM tooling absorbs syntax conversion, proprietary projects may be inaccessible, and physical I/O, safety, timing, and process behavior cannot be proved by static lint
